svg.title: Omega × ASI
svg.desc: Start with four ELI16 executive-summary slides, then all fifteen module responsibilities and the exercised dependency maps before implementation detail. M1 establishes replaceable ports; M1.2 connects real Hive; M2 adds private memory and guarded revision; M3 adds independent STI and bounded inference; M3.1 accounts for delivery and feedback. M4 connects a generated, shareable native inspect result to an isolated real chain and checks its actual post-state effect plus matching deploy-effect finality. The cognition and commitment paths stay separate. Suggested delivery: 50–55 minutes through slide 43; nine appendices support discussion. Tested source 55ed5402391ab6ed14f8ab20e1eea4c85d8be955; evidence-only descendant 05b1c52cfa6ced6e263700753e82ad6038a3b0dd. Presentation changes do not rerun integrations or expand their guarantees.
svg.text: Private cognition, explicit delivery closure and verified chain commitments
Architecture and evidence • 16 October 2026 • supported local scope
